card.name: Start of the word thrombocytopenia
card.fires_on: The first piece of "thrombocytopenia" ("throm" or "Th" + "rom"), just before "bocytopenia". It appears in lists of blood count problems such as anemia and neutropenia.

modes.description: Opening piece of thrombocytopenia after anemia, neutropenia, or leukopenia in an adverse-effect list.

modes.label: After a severity word
modes.description: Opening piece of thrombocytopenia after words like severe, persistent, or Grade 4.

card.writes: It promotes "plate" and "plates", fitting platelet-related words that follow thrombocytopenia.
card.plain: It fires on the start of the word thrombocytopenia (low platelets) and points toward platelet words.
